name: Bruton Parish Church
scope: Bruton Parish Church in Williamsburg in its documented April 2007 appearance. Includes the mapped cruciform brick church, west brick tower and two-stage steeple, shingle roofs and south transept entrance. The separately mapped churchyard, graves, traffic and street objects are outside the asset.

originalReview.notes: The south elevation shows the square brick tower, stacked white octagonal steeple stages, brown shingles, Flemish bond and round-headed windows, and a circular window above the south transept door.

review.method: Published Qualla native file with exact Commons SHA-1, matching original uploader and explicit public-domain dedication
review.notes: One exact published Qualla exterior was accepted. Original upload attribution agrees with its public-domain dedication. The photo date is supported by native EXIF. Earlier postcards and the painted historical interpretation were excluded from the 2007 appearance.
